records.text: Vanessa Bryant's first interview after Kobe Bryant's death was four months later in April and occurred because she was accepting his Hall of Fame induction.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: just so you know, that wasn't until four months later in April and they were not invited into her home. And it was because she was accepting on behalf of Kobe him being inducted into the Hall of Fame.

verification.notes: ESPN confirms Vanessa Bryant spoke by FaceTime on April 4, 2020 after Kobe Bryant was elected to the Hall of Fame. But Kobe died January 26, only about 69 days earlier, not four months; the April appearance reacted to his election, while the formal acceptance on his behalf occurred at the May 2021 enshrinement.
